context: Evaluates whether the model uses WindowGetSize to retrieve window dimensions and WindowSetSize to apply them. The key challenge is knowing the exact Size interface shape (w and h fields) returned by WindowGetSize and the correct argument order for WindowSetSize.

checklist.name: WindowGetSize used
checklist.description: WindowGetSize from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside getDimensions

checklist.name: Promise returned from get
checklist.description: getDimensions returns the Promise that WindowGetSize returns, without unwrapping or re-wrapping it

checklist.name: WindowSetSize used
checklist.description: WindowSetSize from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside setDimensions

checklist.name: Correct arg order for set
checklist.description: WindowSetSize is called with width as the first argument and height as the second argument
